instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium close-up. Against a solid dusty rose background, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a white button-down shirt stands in the foreground, smiling warmly and looking to the left. Behind her, the woman with long straight dark hair (R2) in a denim jacket hugs her from behind, wrapping her arms around her shoulders and smiling joyfully. Soft, even studio lighting illuminates the scene with a warm, clean color palette.
elements: R2 wraps her arms around R1's shoulders from behind
R1 is the foreground person being embraced from behind by R2
R2 is the rear person doing the shoulder-wrapping contact
R1 smiles in front while R2 smiles behind her

questions.q: Is R2 behind R1 wrapping her arms around R1's shoulders, rather than R1 being behind R2 wrapping her arms around R2's shoulders?
questions.element: R2 performs the rear shoulder-wrapping embrace on R1

questions.q: Is R1 the person in the foreground receiving the from-behind shoulder wrap, rather than R2 receiving it from R1?
questions.element: R1 is the recipient of R2's rear embrace

questions.q: Are R2's arms the ones encircling R1's shoulders from behind, rather than R1's arms encircling R2's shoulders from behind?
questions.element: R2's arms provide the behind-the-shoulders contact

questions.q: Does R1 stand in front while R2 is positioned behind her making shoulder contact?
questions.element: R1 foreground role and R2 rear contact role
